name: approval_scan_dollar_paren_end
notes: Balanced $(...) scanner (src/tools/approval.c::scan_dollar_paren_end vs LIVE tools/approval.py::_scan_dollar_paren_end). REAL PARITY GAP FOUND & FIXED during gating: the C port counted BARE '(' toward depth and handled escapes differently, returning wrong end offsets for inputs like "$(deep($(x)))" or "$(a(b)"; port rewritten to mirror LIVE exactly (depth=1 seeded at '$(', depth++ only on nested '$(', quote-aware with double-quote backslash escapes). Traces the shared rungs: unmatched-branch + normalized end-offset value. Inputs carry trailing context because the C sentinel for unmatched equals buffer end.
